1) 先确认机器本身是否存活（ping、远程桌面），宕机要按宕机处理；2) 机器: 1) First confirm the machine itself is alive (ping, Remote Desktop) — if it is down, handle it as a host outage; 2) If it is alive, run Get-Service categraf to check the service state and Start-Service categraf if it is stopped; 3) Check the logs under the categraf log directory — the usual causes are a config error or network/auth failure to the server; 4) After recovery, confirm the data is continuous, and note that failures during the blind window produced no alerts at all.
1) 在资源管理器或用 Get-PSDrive 确认是哪个盘符；2) 用 Get: 1) Identify the drive letter in Explorer or with Get-PSDrive; 2) Run Get-ChildItem <drive>:\ -Recurse -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Sort-Object Length -Descending | Select-Object -First 20 to find the fastest-growing large files; 3) Start with logs, temporary files (run cleanmgr) and the Windows Update cache at C:\Windows\SoftwareDistribution\Download; 4) Confirm whether something abnormal is writing (an application looping on logs, backups piling up) — without fixing the root cause, cleanup only buys time.
1) 打开任务管理器或运行 Get-Process | Sort-Object: 1) Open Task Manager, or run Get-Process | Sort-Object CPU -Descending | Select-Object -First 10 to find the busiest processes; 2) Use Resource Monitor (resmon) to see whether user or kernel time dominates — high kernel time points at drivers or antivirus; 3) Tell traffic growth apart from a program fault (infinite loop, frequent GC); 4) For growth, scale out or rate limit; for a fault, restart the service and fix it.
1) 打开资源监视器（resmon）的「磁盘」页，按「响应时间」排序看是哪块盘、: 1) Open Resource Monitor (resmon), go to the Disk tab and sort by response time to see which disk and which file; 2) Run Get-Counter '\PhysicalDisk(*)\Avg. Disk sec/Transfer' to check average response time; 3) Use Resource Monitor to find the process doing the most IO — usually a database, a backup job or an antivirus full scan; 4) Move deferrable work off peak; if the load is sustained, consider SSDs or spreading the data.
1) 用 Get-EventLog -LogName System -Newes: 1) Run Get-EventLog -LogName System -Newest 50, or use Event Viewer to look for Event ID 6008 (unexpected shutdown) and 1074 (planned shutdown and its initiator) to find the cause; 2) If Windows Update triggered it, evaluate adjusting the update window and restart policy; 3) If it was a bugcheck or power loss, check the minidump and hardware logs; 4) Confirm critical services started automatically after the reboot (check startup type with Get-Service).
1) 用 Get-PSDrive 或资源管理器确认是哪个盘符；2) 用 Tree: 1) Identify the drive letter with Get-PSDrive or Explorer; 2) Use a tool like TreeSize, or Get-ChildItem -Recurse | Sort-Object Length -Descending | Select-Object -First 20, to find the large files; 3) Start with logs, temporary files (cleanmgr) and the Windows Update cache (C:\Windows\SoftwareDistribution\Download); 4) Longer term, expand the disk or move the data directory to another volume.
1) 用 Get-PSDrive 确认盘符与剩余空间；2) 用 TreeSize: 1) Run Get-PSDrive to confirm the drive letter and free space; 2) Use a tool like TreeSize, or Get-ChildItem <drive>:\ -Recurse -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Sort-Object Length -Descending | Select-Object -First 20, to find the largest files and directories; 3) Clean up logs and expired data, and tier cold data off data disks per the business archiving policy; 4) Evaluate whether to expand the disk or move the data directory to another volume.
1) 用 Get-PSDrive 确认盘符与剩余空间；2) 系统盘常见占用是 W: 1) Run Get-PSDrive to confirm the drive letter and free space; 2) On a system disk the usual consumers are the Windows Update cache (C:\Windows\SoftwareDistribution\Download), the hibernation file hiberfil.sys and the page file; 3) Run cleanmgr /sdclean for disk cleanup, and powercfg /h off to disable hibernation and reclaim space if appropriate; 4) Longer term, expand the disk or move large data directories to another volume.
1) 运行 Get-NetAdapterStatistics 确认发包丢弃与错误: 1) Run Get-NetAdapterStatistics to confirm outbound discard and error counters are growing; 2) Use Get-NetAdapterAdvancedProperty to check the Transmit Buffers setting; 3) Check whether the link is saturated (Resource Monitor's Network tab) — if so throttle or add bandwidth; 4) Update the NIC driver and check the peer switch port state.
1) 运行 Get-NetAdapterStatistics 确认发包错误计数的: 1) Run Get-NetAdapterStatistics to confirm outbound error counters are growing; 2) Use Get-NetAdapter to confirm speed and duplex match the peer; 3) Check the cable/optical module and cross-check by swapping; 4) Update the NIC driver and confirm whether the link is saturated and needs more bandwidth.
1) 运行 Get-NetAdapterStatistics 确认收包丢弃与错误: 1) Run Get-NetAdapterStatistics to confirm inbound discard and error counters are growing; 2) Use Get-NetAdapterAdvancedProperty to check the Receive Buffers setting and raise it if it is small; 3) Use Get-NetAdapter to confirm the negotiated speed and duplex match the peer; 4) Update the NIC driver and ask the network team for the switch port's drop counters.
1) 运行 Get-NetAdapterStatistics 确认收包错误计数的: 1) Run Get-NetAdapterStatistics to confirm inbound error counters are growing; 2) Use Get-NetAdapter to confirm the negotiated speed and duplex match the peer; 3) Check the cable/optical module, swapping the cable or port to cross-check; 4) Update the NIC driver and ask the network team for the switch port's error counters.
1) 运行 Get-Process | Sort-Object WS -Desc: 1) Run Get-Process | Sort-Object WS -Descending | Select-Object -First 10 to find the largest consumers; 2) Use perfmon to watch Available MBytes and Pages/sec — a sustained high Pages/sec means it is already paging heavily; 3) Determine whether it is growth or a process leak — a leak must be located in the application, a restart only helps temporarily; 4) Confirm the page file is sized sensibly and add memory if needed.
Windows 主机 CPU 使用率超过 80%，请求排队等待 CPU，应用响应: Windows host CPU utilization is above 80%; requests queue waiting for CPU and application responses will slow noticeably.
Windows 主机在最近 15 分钟内重启过，重启期间该机承载的服务全部中断。: The Windows host rebooted within the last 15 minutes; every service it hosts was interrupted during the reboot.
Windows 主机物理内存使用率超过 80%，继续增长会大量走页面文件，系统整: Windows host physical memory usage is above 80%; further growth will push heavily onto the page file and slow the whole system down.
Windows 主机网卡入方向错包比例偏高，通常是物理链路或驱动问题，会导致重传: The inbound error packet ratio on the Windows host's NIC is high, usually a physical link or driver problem, causing retransmits and latency jitter.
Windows 主机网卡出方向错包比例偏高，发送侧存在链路或驱动问题，对外请求会: The outbound error packet ratio on the Windows host's NIC is high: the transmit side has a link or driver problem and outbound requests will time out and retransmit.
Windows 逻辑磁盘使用率超过 90%，写满后应用写文件、系统更新、页面文件: Windows logical disk usage is above 90%; once it fills, application file writes, system updates and page file expansion will all fail.
可用内存低于 25%，继续下降会大量走页面文件，系统整体响应变慢甚至出现应用崩溃: Available memory is below 25%; further decline will push heavily onto the page file, slowing the whole system and possibly crashing applications.
大于 200G 的磁盘剩余空间已不足 20G，按大盘的写入速度这个余量很快会被吃: A disk larger than 200G has less than 20G free; at the write rate typical of a large disk that headroom will be consumed quickly.
大于200G的盘，空间不足了[Windows]: Disk larger than 200G is running out of space [Windows]
小于 200G 的磁盘使用率已超过 90%，小盘余量本来就少，触顶会很快。: A disk smaller than 200G is more than 90% used; small disks have little headroom to begin with and will fill quickly.
小于200G的盘，空间不足了[Windows]: Disk smaller than 200G is running out of space [Windows]
按最近 1 小时的写入速度线性外推，该磁盘预计 4 小时内会被写满。Window: Extrapolating the last hour's write rate, this disk is expected to fill within 4 hours. A full Windows disk breaks application file writes, interrupts system updates and prevents page file expansion.
磁盘 IO 使用率接近 100%，请求在排队，所有依赖该磁盘的读写都会变慢。: Disk IO utilization is close to 100% and requests are queueing; every read and write on that disk slows down.
网卡入方向出现丢包，接收侧处理不过来或链路有问题，表现为请求超时、重传增多。: The NIC is dropping inbound packets: the receive side cannot keep up or the link has a problem, causing request timeouts and increased retransmits.
网卡出方向出现丢包，发送队列已经拥塞，对外请求与响应会出现超时和重传。: The NIC is dropping outbound packets: the transmit queue is congested and outbound requests and responses will time out and retransmit.
采集 agent 已超过 60 秒没有上报数据，这台机器处于监控盲区——它上面所: The collector agent has not reported for over 60 seconds. This machine is now a monitoring blind spot — none of its other alert rules can fire.
